attributes.title: The Liver Meeting 2027
attributes.organizer: American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases
attributes.summary:
AASLD will hold The Liver Meeting 2027 in Philadelphia from November 12 to 16, 2027. The dates appear in the association's 2026 program guide, and the meeting page lists November 12 as the first day of TLM27.

The Liver Meeting is the main annual gathering of the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases, covering hepatology research and clinical care, including viral hepatitis, steatotic liver disease, liver cancer and transplantation.

AASLD has not yet announced the venue, registration fees or CME credit totals for 2027. We will add those details when the association publishes them.
